purpose: Planning coverage and future measurement definitions; this file contains no production catalog counts.

measurement_policy.unknown_meaning: Not measured; null is not zero.

requirements.title: Scope and delivery governance
requirements.coverage_intent: A cross-organization delivery boundary, measurable scope and accountable decisions are maintained without duplicating research or clients.

requirements.title: Ecosystem contracts and ontology
requirements.coverage_intent: Versioned pipeline records represent the wider AI ecosystem and project into accepted consumer contracts without mutating frozen v1.

requirements.title: Source rights and use governance
requirements.coverage_intent: Every retrieval and publication operation is evaluated against exact source, field, product and use permissions.

requirements.title: Permitted acquisition and connector runtime
requirements.coverage_intent: Approved adapters collect bounded observations reliably without leaking credentials or turning collection into publication.

requirements.title: Identity resolution and normalization
requirements.coverage_intent: Stable entities, exact releases and provider offers survive aliases, duplicates, merges and corrections with reversible lineage.

requirements.title: Evidence and provenance ledger
requirements.coverage_intent: Every public claim can be traced to a permitted source observation, transformation and reviewed decision.

requirements.title: Validation, quarantine and quality
requirements.coverage_intent: Malformed, conflicting, unsupported and insufficiently evidenced material cannot enter the approved release set.

requirements.title: Human review and editorial control
requirements.coverage_intent: Reviewers make explicit, scoped, auditable decisions; automation cannot silently approve claims or rights.

requirements.title: Prices and qualified measurements
requirements.coverage_intent: Prices, estimates and measurements preserve conditions, units, uncertainty and research qualification.

requirements.title: Immutable publishing and withdrawals
requirements.coverage_intent: Reproducible, signed, rights-eligible snapshots publish atomically and support correction, rollback and revocation.

requirements.title: Freshness and change management
requirements.coverage_intent: Source changes trigger risk-based review while historical version-pinned facts and saved builds remain reproducible.

requirements.title: Website and mobile delivery contracts
requirements.coverage_intent: Consumers receive compatible, attributable, version-pinned artifacts with independently accepted integration evidence.

requirements.title: Security, privacy and supply chain
requirements.coverage_intent: Collection, review and release boundaries resist untrusted content, credential exposure and unauthorized publication.

requirements.title: Platform and operational reliability
requirements.coverage_intent: Jobs, state, storage, deployment and incident response are observable, recoverable and bounded by approved operating costs.

requirements.title: Conformance and quality verification
requirements.coverage_intent: Deterministic and adversarial evidence proves safety, compatibility and reliability at actual system boundaries.

requirements.title: Bounded pilots and ecosystem expansion
requirements.coverage_intent: A rights-eligible pilot establishes the complete delivery path before measured expansion across domains.

domains.title: Model families, releases and artifacts
domains.boundary: Language, vision, audio, multimodal, retrieval, robotics, forecasting and scientific task families; family/release/checkpoint identities stay distinct.
domains.inclusion_rule: An exact entity/revision within accepted research scope with explicit evidence and source-use disposition.
domains.exclusion_rule: Unknown rights, unqualified public claims, unapproved raw datasets/full text, and unsupported consumer projections remain withheld.
domains.consumer_boundary: Pipeline produces approved immutable artifacts; website/mobile own their interfaces and adoption.
